changelog: ✨ Added a Discord-style site update popup (patch notes modal)
🔄 Implemented automatic site version checking using localStorage
📦 Introduced a centralized version.json for site versioning
🧠 Added UpdateManager and useUpdateChecker for update detection
🧩 Integrated site update popup into the global layout
📄 Reworked the Features page to dynamically load app releases from GitHub
📥 Reworked the Download page to dynamically display the latest app version and changelog
🔗 Added a Next.js API route to fetch app version and changelog directly from the GitHub repository
🎨 Improved UI consistency and layout stability across Features and Download pages
🚀 Improved overall site performance and data loading reliability
